items.summary: Separated SGF+ long-generation research, a B200 interactive browser route and a slower RTX 5090 ComfyUI file workflow.
Added AMD Micro-World 2 single-MI350X decoded throughput with its original-versus-light decoder quality and receiver-cost boundaries.
Separated the warm 5090 EdenLive file benchmark from the 80-GB-verified WebRTC service and identified a motion-quality test.
Separated Reactor’s hosted ComfyUI client from local FastH3-Omni weights, and documented the completed-clip playback and displayed rate boundaries.
Added hosted Abot and Lingbot browser routes, their separate use labels and a compute-second versus delivered-hour cost check.
Corrected a transient H3 CI slowdown claim and separated an unmeasured API metadata PR from a delivered-video speed gain.
Added the open Self-Forcing stepwise route and compared first-chunk arrival with sustained 16-fps playout on its reported A800 run.
Added the H3 streaming VAE decoder and separated first-latent decode, reconstruction quality and viewer-visible response.
Added the one-RTX-5090 paired H3 result and separated warm generation from the two-clip HLS viewer gate and managed-GPU price.
Added StreamForce’s browser force-control route and separated generation FPS, local queue lead, startup stalls and short visual-coherence window.
First public release candidate: route map separating open sessions, buffered playout, and local short-clip workflows.
Added a dated source-backed research report with price, hardware, and continuity limits.
Added FastH3 local MLX and DGX Spark route conditions, source timing conversions, and the full-quality versus preview-decode boundary.
Added the distinction between a paced continuous broadcast and hard-cut independent FastH3 scenes, plus qualified local-H3 access conditions.
Added FastH3’s manual-default versus optional-autoplay playout boundary, a current Director price-expiry warning, and fresh longform-local and workflow-version conditions.
Corrected the FastH3 high-end timing into separate four- and eight-B200 conditions, updated Director to its current list price, and added a condition-rich local 5090 signal.
Added a condition-bound consumer FastH3 channel report: the source-stated one-5090 route, its 22.1-fps claim, retiming, prequeue, square-canvas, and interaction limits.
Added Yoroll’s source-stated eight-B200 H3 Superfast / YoLive route, separating group-selected next-scene interaction from held sessions and local playout.
Added vLLM-Omni’s remote H3 serving route and its named four-B300 full-H3 FL2VA latency condition, separating an API endpoint from a live-video promise.
Added FastVideo’s 8-Step V2 / ComfyUI package route and its unresolved T2AV-versus-FL2VA task-scope conflict; warned readers to verify a pinned transition workflow before promising it.
Added a condition-rich RTX 5090 FastH3 Preview benchmark, separating faster clip review and prequeue from playback-rate or interactive-video claims.
Rechecked FastH3 8-Step V2 against the exact FastVideo model card and current official ComfyUI image-to-video template; kept FL2VA as unresolved and added a pre-download validation card.
Added a condition-rich community FastH3 V2 Radeon result, its native-canvas timing conversion, the stated VSA threshold limit, and the still-unresolved official FL2VA template conflict.

Added FastVideo’s documented Dreamverse FastH3 Preview v1 profile: four-GPU default, 124-frame frame-carried segments, cold readiness boundary, and the limit that this is not yet a live-capacity result.
Added vLLM-Omni’s condition-bound eight-B300 FastH3 T2VA complete-MP4 result: faster than playback at the returned-artifact boundary, not a live-stream result.
Added vLLM-Omni’s documented two-RTX-5090 full-H3 T2VA capacity check: 5.17 seconds of output in 8 minutes 38 seconds, with the host-RAM and non-live boundary.
Added the vLLM-Omni H3 server-versus-current-ComfyUI-client boundary: two-keyframe and richer-reference capability must be checked at the client, not inferred from the endpoint.
Added vLLM-Omni’s named four-request H3 co-batching boundary and clarified that the documented two-RTX-5090 DLO profile selects the FL2VA task path rather than proving a live or all-task service.
Added a condition-bound ComfyUI H3 VAE stage A/B and separated it from whole-render and live-video speed.
Added vLLM-Omni v0.30.0 Ref2VA long-video continuation and its eight-B300 30.667-second example, while separating a completed clip from a measured live stream.
Added vLLM-Omni’s eight-B300 short FastH3 complete-response result and the exact adapter/task/schedule boundary; separated it from denoiser speed and longer-clip results.
Added Vidu S2 live Editing as a distinct source-fed RTC/RTMP route, with endpoint-specific $18-per-billed-hour list-rate arithmetic and unresolved viewer latency.
Added NVIDIA Sol-H3 eight-B300 warm timing and the final-encoding, adapter, and live-service boundaries.
Added TaoMate-H3 eight-H20 first-playable benchmark and separated the official chunked runtime from a consumer LoRA adaptation.
Added a condition-bound warm eight-H100 FastH3 complete-MP4 result and separated the eight-H200 patch comparison.
Added the H3 mask-editing API and ComfyUI client-status distinction, with an offline-versus-live warning.
Added a full-duplex Griffin-Lite watchlist route and separated component latency, independent benchmark event timing, and unavailable customer access.
Separated RAVEN’s H200 memory-envelope and synthetic long run from its short real-prompt test; added hardware pre-purchase check.
Added a 5070 H3 whole-job comparison that separates the 7.1× attention claim from a 2.63× complete-render gain and an offline-only result.
Added ShotStream H200 paper-throughput check and public CSV-to-final-MP4 client boundary.
Separated five-H100 avatar streaming throughput and first-frame timing from a one-H200 cold finished-clip result and the unmeasured conversation service.
Added Hallo-Live text-to-audio-video benchmark, saved-file client boundary, default VRAM condition, and a model-versus-live-client decision.
Added Scope WebRTC client path and the commercial, cold-start and hour-handover gates for a paid live show.
Separated four-H100 LingBot-World v2 target compute from the later LiveKit client and session clock.
Added the released eight-GB200 StreamRender-H3 browser route, separated render, GPU and browser publication clocks, and named scenario and cost limits.
Added a one-GPU Waypoint browser route with distinct generation, delivery, response, cold-start and coherence limits.
Added the merged TaoMate-H3 WebSocket video route, its one-session H200-class conditions and the separate open audio work.
Compared FastH3 Omni completed-MP4 timing by reference workload and separated eight-GB200, local and live-receiver claims.
Updated the one-RTX-5090 H3 route to its source-reported native-rate clip result, with the exact setup, viewer-control limit and rights gate.
Added the source-reported browser keypress median with eight-Blackwell deployment and missing p95 and cost boundaries.
